source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical repair changes both target.deb from lists to release-deb-repackage instead of generic repackage. Accepted current manifests use later repackage-deb with a matching distinct package kind. Keep the exact source kind and revision paired when reviewing this configuration; historical names and current graph names differ. Mapping text alone does not prove a produced artifact, correct checksum or successful FTP push. No graph/task/build was run.
title: The Debian upload mapping must select the matching package-producing task kind
